evidence.original_label: 第500台步进光刻机交付仪式
evidence.excerpt: 8月8日，上海芯上微装科技股份有限公司（简称：AMIES）举办了第500台步进光刻机交付仪式。此次发运的第500台步进光刻机将交付给盛合晶微，后者是集成电路晶圆级先进封测企业。

notes: AMIES's own company-counted cumulative-delivery milestone: its 500th 'step lithography machine' ('第500台步进光刻机'), delivered 2025-08-08 to SJ Semiconductor (盛合晶微), a wafer-level advanced-packaging/test firm. Exact event date (article byline 2025-08-08 18:27) is stated in the source. SCOPE WARNING: continues SMEE's pre-2025 lithography-tool delivery count (see SMEE-LITHO-100TH-DELIVERY-2018) across both front-end and packaging/LED/FPD product lines combined -- not attributable to a single platform; sits at the lithography PARENT category and is deliberately not attached to either amies_wafer_level_packaging_stepper's or amies_panel_level_packaging_stepper's maturity_history.
